title: Brush primer on lasted shoe
refit_note: while the right hand wraps the brush (2.4–8.8 s) its fingers are mostly hidden by the handle and the hand model misreads the grip, so there the 3D hand is the grip from a clearly seen frame (0.8 s) placed on the brush handle's 3D axis, turned and slid to match the hand's outline and depth. Its finger pose is that frame's, not measured on each frame.
